items.html: But know a great rule, that the Nefesh alone is included of all five Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida, and all of them are Nefesh alone. And their like are five phases, and all of them are called Ruach. And so too in Neshama, and so too in Haya, and so too in Yechida. And it is known that ZA in its entirety is called Ruach, and it has Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida in it. And in its Nefesh there are five phases of Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida, and so too the Ruach, etc. In such a way that they are five phases, each one included of five, which are twenty-five phases, and all of them are called Ruach alone. And so too are the twenty-five phases in the Nukva. And all of them are called Nefesh.
